statement.notes: 1. 'total_operating_cost' is calculated as the sum of 'Cost of sales', 'Marketing and selling expenses', and 'General and administrative expenses'. This is a standard proxy for total operating expenses in the absence of a single line item. 2. 'interest_expenses' is mapped from 'Net financial income/(expense)' as it represents the net financial cost, which is primarily interest. For 2024, the net financial expense is 792, but this includes 'Cost of net financial debt' (442) and 'Interest on lease liabilities' (510). The sum of these two explicit interest items (952) is used for 'interest_expenses' to be more precise. The same logic is applied for 2023 (367+393=760) and 2022 (17+254=271). However, the 'Net financial income/(expense)' line includes other items (e.g., foreign exchange, fair value adjustments), so using the sum of the explicit interest lines is more accurate. 3. 'taxes' is mapped from 'Income taxes'. 4. 'net_income' is mapped from 'Net profit, Group share'. 5. All values are in EUR millions as per the statement.
